dialogues.speaker: Jazari
dialogues.text: I've applied for it, but haven't heard anything since then... Could the academic trends have changed recently?

dialogues.speaker: Jazari
dialogues.text: As the saying goes, "The road to happiness is fraught with setbacks." Sometimes one has to wait a bit longer for a positive outcome.

dialogues.speaker: Jazari
dialogues.text: Don't worry, when that day comes, I won't forget your contribution.
